scripts.bench:core:all: cross-env BENCH_ALL=true BENCH_OUTPUT_FILE=results/core.json vitest bench suites/core --reporter=./reporters/json-bench.ts
scripts.bench:apps:build: run-p "pnpm --dir apps/react install && pnpm --dir apps/react build" "pnpm --dir apps/vue install && pnpm --dir apps/vue build"
scripts.bench:full: run-s bench:apps:build bench:core:all bench:correctness bench:browser bench:merge bench:generate
scripts.bench:update-baseline: node -e "if (!process.env.CI) { console.error('[bench] bench:update-baseline must run on CI only'); process.exit(1); }" && cp results/latest.json results/baseline.json
